[Backup plan] If results are poor, I'd simplify the entry to just donchian breakout with a dynamic RSI filter (e.g., RSI must be above 50 for 3 consecutive bars). If Sharpe is low, reduce RSI overbought/oversold thresholds to 65/35 and widen donchian period. As an alternative, I'd test a volatility-adjusted mean-reversion approach using Bollinger Bands instead of Donchian channels.
